name: CaseAntdOverlayDigitDepthThree
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-overlay-digit-depth-three" (anatomy). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: sup(absolute, translate(50%,-50%)) > bdi > span > span — a count digit THREE levels deep in an absolutely positioned overlay, the deepest span carrying NO identity class (antd's rc-scroll-number `current` is transient and dropped by classAllow; the fixture spells the same absence with a bare span — the frontier eval refuses any non-neutral class in a case)
